If I could make one change to iOS 27 and iPadOS 27, it would be to disable the new "swipe down" gesture for summoning Siri AI. There are already enough ways to summon Siri, but this new gesture specifically disrupts my long-established habit of opening the notification center on iPhone and iPad.

Meanwhile, on the Mac side, macOS 27 Golden Gate is almost entirely good news. Even at the end of August, new betas are still adding welcome changes. However, before macOS 27 officially launches next month, there is still one change I would like to see.

MacBook battery percentage becomes harder to read in macOS 27 Golden Gate

macOS 27 Golden Gate has adopted a redesigned battery menu bar control. By default, it does not show the percentage, only a battery-shaped icon.

It looks good in this state. I also turn off the percentage display on my iPhone, where the battery icon is the same. However, on the Mac, I have always preferred to show the percentage.

If you enable the "Show Percentage" option in macOS 27 Golden Gate, the number appears inside the battery icon. I believe this is to maintain consistency with the iPhone design in iOS 27.

Putting the percentage inside the battery icon on iPhone was a compromise by Apple to address the lack of space on the right side of the screen (outside the notch or Dynamic Island). But on the Mac, even in the menu bar, I do not have this kind of screen space issue.

I have been running macOS 27 Golden Gate on my 15-inch MacBook Air since the first developer beta was released on day one. I have found that my overall attention to the battery percentage has decreased, because its readability has worsened for my eyes.

I hope Apple will reconsider this design decision in the future, especially if more users encounter the same issue. In the meantime, I have at least resolved this problem for myself.

I used Codex to create a simple menu bar utility that clearly displays the current battery status and percentage, matching the visual effect I expected. If you find this helpful, you can click here to download and install it for free.
